verses.text: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children;
verses.textZh: 所以，你們該效法神，好像蒙慈愛的兒女一樣。

verses.text: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved you and gave Himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God as a fragrant aroma.
verses.textZh: 也要憑愛心行事，正如基督愛我們，為我們捨了自己，當作馨香的供物和祭物，獻與神。

verses.text: But immorality or any impurity or greed must not even be named among you, as is proper among saints;
verses.textZh: 至於淫亂並一切污穢，或是貪婪，在你們中間連題都不可，方合聖徒的體統。

verses.text: and [there must be no] filthiness and silly talk, or coarse jesting, which are not fitting, but rather giving of thanks.
verses.textZh: 淫詞、妄語，和戲笑的話都不相宜；總要說感謝的話。

verses.text: For this you know with certainty, that no immoral or impure person or covetous man, who is an idolater, has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.textZh: 因為你們確實的知道，無論是淫亂的，是污穢的，是有貪心的，在基督和神的國裡都是無分的。有貪心的，就與拜偶像的一樣。

verses.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
verses.textZh: 不要被人虛浮的話欺哄；因這些事，神的忿怒必臨到那悖逆之子。

verses.text: Therefore do not be partakers with them;
verses.textZh: 所以，你們不要與他們同夥。

verses.text: for you were formerly darkness, but now you are Light in the Lord; walk as children of Light
verses.textZh: 從前你們是暗昧的，但如今在主裡面是光明的，行事為人就當像光明的子女。

verses.text: (for the fruit of the Light [consists] in all goodness and righteousness and truth),
verses.textZh: 光明所結的果子就是一切良善、公義、誠實。

verses.text: trying to learn what is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.textZh: 總要察驗何為主所喜悅的事。

verses.text: Do not participate in the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but instead even expose them;
verses.textZh: 那暗昧無益的事，不要與人同行，倒要責備行這事的人；

verses.text: for it is disgraceful even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
verses.textZh: 因為他們暗中所行的，就是題起來也是可恥的。

verses.text: But all things become visible when they are exposed by the light, for everything that becomes visible is light.
verses.textZh: 凡事受了責備，就被光顯明出來，因為一切能顯明的就是光。

verses.text: For this reason it says, 'Awake, sleeper, And arise from the dead, And Christ will shine on you.'
verses.textZh: 所以主說：你這睡著的人當醒過來，從死裡復活！基督就要光照你了。

verses.text: Therefore be careful how you walk, not as unwise men but as wise,
verses.textZh: 你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。

verses.text: making the most of your time, because the days are evil.
verses.textZh: 要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。

verses.text: So then do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.textZh: 不要作糊塗人，要明白主的旨意如何。

verses.text: And do not get drunk with wine, for that is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.textZh: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放蕩；乃要被聖靈充滿。

verses.text: speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your heart to the Lord;
verses.textZh: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此對說，口唱心和的讚美主。

verses.text: always giving thanks for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;
verses.textZh: 凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父神。

verses.text: and be subject to one another in the fear of Christ.
verses.textZh: 又當存敬畏基督的心，彼此順服。

verses.text: Wives, [be subject] to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.textZh: 你們作妻子的，當順服自己的丈夫，如同順服主。

verses.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, He Himself [being] the Savior of the body.
verses.textZh: 因為丈夫是妻子的頭，如同基督是教會的頭；他又是教會全體的救主。

verses.text: But as the church is subject to Christ, so also the wives [ought to be] to their husbands in everything.
verses.textZh: 教會怎樣順服基督，妻子也要怎樣凡事順服丈夫。

verses.text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her,
verses.textZh: 你們作丈夫的，要愛你們的妻子，正如基督愛教會，為教會捨己。

verses.text: so that He might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.textZh: 要用水藉著道把教會洗淨，成為聖潔，

verses.text: that He might present to Himself the church in all her glory, having no spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that she would be holy and blameless.
verses.textZh: 可以獻給自己，作個榮耀的教會，毫無玷污、皺紋等類的病，乃是聖潔沒有瑕疵的。

verses.text: So husbands ought also to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself;
verses.textZh: 丈夫也當照樣愛妻子，如同愛自己的身子；愛妻子便是愛自己了。

verses.text: for no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ also [does] the church,
verses.textZh: 從來沒有人恨惡自己的身子，總是保養顧惜，正像基督待教會一樣，

verses.text: because we are members of His body.
verses.textZh: 因我們是他身上的肢體（有古卷在此有：就是他的骨他的肉）。

verses.text: FOR THIS REASON A MAN SHALL LEAVE HIS FATHER AND MOTHER AND SHALL BE JOINED TO HIS WIFE, AND THE TWO SHALL BECOME ONE FLESH.
verses.textZh: 為這個緣故，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。

verses.text: This mystery is great; but I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church.
verses.textZh: 這是極大的奧祕，但我是指著基督和教會說的。

verses.text: Nevertheless, each individual among you also is to love his own wife even as himself, and the wife must [see to it] that she respects her husband.
verses.textZh: 然而，你們各人都當愛妻子，如同愛自己一樣。妻子也當敬重他的丈夫。
